name: Littoral-Dirge
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by bioluminescent seas. Beyond tectonic rift valleys, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Surveyors date the ancient alien ruins to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
There is money in water here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
